note: Maintained subsystem notes describe bounded development support. Partial never means a whole subsystem is complete. Shared framework rows do not certify every host backend.

areas.name: Java / DEX runtime
areas.notes: Standalone ART (with pre-warmed WarmArtPool standby wired into HostSession and ShirazDaemon on both Linux and macOS, ART MAP_JIT/mach_vm_remap/ARM64 fault-handler primitives on Darwin, and AOT/page-cache pre-warming on Linux), active-session AlarmManager wakeup delivery (unblocking AndroidX WorkManager), multi-DEX loading, and all 4,445 Android API 35 android.* class surfaces compile and smoke-test on OpenJDK and ART. Complete method-level Android behavior and Darwin libart-compiler.so JIT remain incremental.

areas.name: Views, input and lifecycle
areas.notes: Layouts, widgets, transitions, property animations, accessibility nodes, IME sessions, pointer input and resizing are exercised; complex custom app flows still expose gaps.

areas.name: Resources and themes
areas.notes: APK resources, binary XML attributes, ICU formatting, density/configuration changes and selected theme paths work; full Material theme parity remains incomplete.

areas.name: Files and preferences
areas.notes: Committed preferences, queued apply writes, PreferenceScreen hierarchies, unified Linux/macOS/Windows OS data paths and DocumentsContract/MediaStore URI models pass OpenJDK/ART tests. Telegram saved-login persistence is still unverified.

areas.name: SQLite storage
areas.notes: Host SQLite, CursorWindow, MergeCursor, CursorJoiner, SQLiteQueryBuilder and SQLiteRawStatement are exercised; every Android SQLite edge case is not established.

areas.name: Networking and TLS
areas.notes: Guest sockets, TLS, DnsResolver, HttpEngine over HttpURLConnection and LinkProperties/IKEv2 models exist; a historical targeted network run records 49 passes while the full suite remains unrun.

areas.name: Binder and Android services
areas.notes: Selected in-process/host IPC services, AccountManager, Telecom CallControl and service SPI classes exist. Full Android system_server behavior and cross-process compatibility are not established.

areas.name: Canvas, EGL and GLES
areas.notes: Real apps render through software/host EGL/GLES paths alongside ColorSpace connectors, ImageDecoder, YuvImage and OpenGL Matrix/ETC1 helpers. Full hardware-accelerated RenderNode parity is not verified.

areas.name: PDF, print and gestures
areas.notes: Pure-Java %PDF-1.4 writer, software PDF rasterizer, text search/selection/annotations, PrintDocumentAdapter pipelines and 2D gesture stroke recognition pass on OpenJDK and ART; host print spooling is not wired.

areas.name: Media containers, EXIF and RenderScript
areas.notes: WAV/ISO-BMFF MediaExtractor and MediaMuxer, TIFF/JPEG ExifInterface read-write, DTMF ToneGenerator, Visualizer DFT and CPU RenderScript intrinsics pass component tests; broad codec coverage remains bounded.

areas.name: AppSearch, Health Connect and AdServices
areas.notes: In-memory AppSearch BM25 indexing, Health Connect typed records/unit conversions and AdServices models pass on OpenJDK and ART; cross-app Android system stores are not emulated.

areas.name: Keystore, Identity, Credentials and NDEF
areas.notes: Host keystore entries, ISO 18013-5 Identity Credential COSE/CBOR sessions, CredentialManager models and NFC Forum NDEF/BLE scan wire codecs work in-process; Secure Element, NFC RF and Bluetooth radios fail explicitly.

areas.name: NDK native C/C++ libraries
areas.verification: Native unit tests and nm audit
areas.notes: All 15 tracked Android API 35 NDK shared libraries (887/887 cataloged C symbols across libandroid, libjnigraphics, libmediandk, libsync, libOpenSLES, libaaudio, liblog, libicu, libamidi, libcamera2ndk, libOpenMAXAL, libbinder_ndk, libneuralnetworks, libvulkan and libnativewindow) build and pass native behavioral tests, including VK_KHR_android_surface ANativeWindow swapchain, AHardwareBuffer memory bridges, pinned MoltenVK v1.4.2 live Metal Vulkan 1.4.357 on Apple M2 Pro (host libvulkan.so, Darwin guest AAPCS64 thunks, and Java PackageManager level=1), and AppImage/Flatpak bundling; live Vulkan game rendering remains unverified and physical Camera2 hardware capture remains host-dependent.

areas.name: Android native ELF / Bionic
areas.notes: Opt-in guest loader (SHIRAZ_GUEST_LOADER=1) boots OsmAnd+ (7 native libs, 4,090 TPIDR rewrites, live Tehran vector maps, turn-by-turn pedestrian routing & 468 MB HTTPS downloads), F-Droid v2.0.2, Math (2 ARM64 libs), and Telegram (18 constructors, JNI_OnLoad), adds pinned MoltenVK v1.4.2 live Metal Vulkan 1.4.357 + Darwin guest libvulkan.so AAPCS64 thunks, powl/sqrtl, property read callbacks, dynamic library admission, and unified 16 KB page-size policy. M5 strict hardened-runtime signing gate and full syscall coverage remain open.

areas.name: Audio playback, AAC and Opus
areas.notes: AudioToolbox AudioQueue hardware AAudio and PCM output, WAV/AAC/Opus decode (AudioToolbox), AAC encode and timestamps tested with synthetic media and live CoreAudio output. Telegram voice messages and calls remain unverified.

areas.name: VideoToolbox hardware decode
areas.notes: libshiraz-video.so decodes H.264, HEVC, VP9 and AV1 through VideoToolbox alongside AudioToolbox Opus; end-to-end app playback and DRM remain unverified.

areas.name: macOS notifications, location, Metal and gestures
areas.notes: UNUserNotificationCenter notifications, CoreLocation wired into Android LocationManager, 120 Hz CVDisplayLink hardware vsync pacing, zero-copy IOSurface swapchain, SurfaceTexture, AHardwareBuffer EGLImage & EGL_ANDROID_native_fence_sync (MTLSharedEvent), Security.framework TLS trust (32/32 wolfJSSE/OkHttp + OsmAnd+ HTTPS fetch), AVFoundation speech voices, App Nap guard, Cocoa live-resize events, Retina 2x/fractional pointer mapping, Cmd-to-Ctrl shortcuts and trackpad pinch/touch filtering are verified on Apple Silicon; interactive TCC prompts in end-user apps remain under test.

areas.name: Signed macOS .app bundle builder
areas.notes: Builds self-contained signed Shiraz.app bundles with hardened runtime, allow-jit and optional --sandbox App Sandbox entitlements, @rpath library closure and generated .icns icons, plus browser Go/WASM .app sidecar zip packaging (keeping signed Shiraz.app byte-for-byte untouched beside AppData/) and SwiftUI Launcher default-on Seatbelt + MoltenVK ICD wiring; notarized release distribution is not yet published.

areas.name: Microphone and camera
areas.notes: Host bridges and foreground consent checks exist; physical capture in Telegram has not been verified. JPEG tests use synthetic pixels.

areas.name: Video recording
areas.notes: The macOS video-recording pipeline is not implemented. Audio-only recording APIs do not imply video support.

areas.name: Android sensors
areas.notes: No Android sensor event bridge is advertised on Darwin.

areas.name: Remote media / casting
areas.notes: Only a local default audio route is provided. Remote and cast routing are unavailable.

areas.name: Windows Win32 host primitives and IPC
areas.notes: 32/37 goal checklist items CI-verified and 5 partial (0 open): CreateFileMappingW shared memory, WaitForMultipleObjects looper, Named Pipe IPC with peer PID lookup, DXGI GPU probe, EnumDisplaySettingsW refresh rate, Per-Monitor V2 DPI & ANGLE-D3D11 window wiring, DXGI shared AHardwareBuffer pool, Win32 sync fences, DwmFlush choreographer pacing, libvulkan.dll ANativeWindow swapchain/AHB bridge, SDL2 Win32 presentation/IME/clipboard/keyboard (test-presentation.exe), CreateProcessW spawning, SetThreadExecutionState, Job Object + Restricted Token sandbox, Win32 ART NativeBridge v3 C ABI adapter (libshiraz-win32-guest.dll) + guest ELF loader with W^X VirtualAlloc & SysV↔Win64 thunks, pinned patches/art-win32-build.patch + bootstrap_windows.py ART orchestrator, and HostOs/rundll32 launchers. Live Win32 libart.dll execution remains open.

areas.name: Windows WASAPI, Media Foundation, DirectWrite and services
areas.notes: WASAPI PCM16 playback & capture bridge backing libaaudio.dll and libOpenSLES.dll, Media Foundation H.264/HEVC decoder probing, MFEnumDeviceSources camera enumeration and IMFSourceReader RGBA8888 frame capture (shiraz_win32_camera_capture_frame), DirectWrite system font enumeration, GetAdaptersAddresses connectivity, DPAPI keystore, SAPI5 speech probe, Shell_NotifyIconW notifications and Windows Location COM bridges build and pass MinGW-w64 CI tests (make windows-check); interactive end-to-end app media playback on Windows is not yet verified.

areas.name: Windows portable and MSIX bundler
areas.notes: Portable Shiraz\ directory and MSIX AppxManifest.xml bundler with PE32/PE32+ import closure, .ico generation, and Start Menu install-desktop integration, validated in 3-OS CI; signed Windows installer releases are not yet published.

areas.name: App isolation and sandboxing
areas.verification: Native, CLI and Python policy tests
areas.notes: Default-on cross-platform SandboxPolicy enforced across shiraz run, shiraz install-desktop, shiraz daemon, and Linux AppImages (--no-sandbox opt-out, --no-network/--no-internet): maps to Linux Landlock LSM + PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS + seccomp-BPF network deny (plus Flatpak bubblewrap bundles), macOS Seatbelt (sandbox-exec) SBPL profiles + App Sandbox entitlements, and Windows Job Objects + Restricted Tokens; OS process confinement is not Android's full per-UID/SELinux sandbox.

areas.name: WebView JavaScript / DOM
areas.notes: Embedded pure-Java HTML5 DOM parser, CSS selector engine, interactive contentEditable/<textarea>/<input> editing bridged to EditText, Selection/Range & document.execCommand, MutationObserver, Handler-backed setTimeout/requestAnimationFrame/queueMicrotask, localStorage/sessionStorage, step-budgeted JavaScript evaluator, @JavascriptInterface reflection bridge, postWebMessage, findAllAsync and multi-entry back/forward history pass OpenJDK/ART tests; a full Blink/V8 CSS layout browser engine for complex SPAs is not bundled.

areas.name: Google Play services runtime
areas.notes: Shiraz does not provide the Google Play Store or Google Play system services. Bundled client libraries do not supply those services.

areas.name: Cellular telephony and SMS
areas.notes: E.164 formatting, GSM 7-bit/UCS-2 SMS PDU codecs and CellInfo models work in Java, but Shiraz makes no claim of real modem control, phone calls or carrier SMS.

areas.name: Android platform certification
areas.notes: No complete CTS/VTS run, complete API behavior result or whole-platform compatibility percentage is established.
